title: Generative AI Work Shadowing - Particle6
description: Observed the integration of GenAI tools(Kling AI, HiggsField, and ElevenLabs) into professional media pipelines to accelerate content delivery.
Applied advanced meta-prompting techniques to refine LLM outputs and maintain character consistency across video generation models.
Evaluated hybrid human-AI workflows, balancing automated generation with manual human authorship and quality oversight.

title: Web Development Internship - Openlaunch
description: Developed a full-stack voting system for the National AI Competition 2025, featuring a Next.js and React-strong user interface and admin dashboard. Integrated Qdrant for efficient vote data storage and used cookie-based tracking to ensure secure and reliable participation from over 1,000 users.

Developed an AI-powered CV semantic search system using Gemini Flash embeddings and Qdrant vector database to perform high-accuracy similarity matching. Optimised retrieval by implementing custom text chunking and cosine similarity scoring to rank and deliver the top 10 most relevant candidates based on semantic intent.
